answer_1.quote: We employ three datasets, including TL;DR, UltraFeedback-P (UF-P)... In TL;DR we define two user groups: one prefers short summaries, the other favors long summaries.

answer_3.quote: Based on the learned user embeddings e_u, we build a reward model... We use an LLM-based reward function where f is an LLM parameterized by φ taking user embedding e_u and the response r as inputs and predicts preference score.
